name: forkhead box A1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FOXA1 encodes hepatocyte nuclear factor 3-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Prostate adenocarcinoma; Neuroendocrine tumor of breast; Invasive lobular carcinoma of breast. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
